title: Fact envelope v1
description: Fields every fact line carries. Payload fields sit next to them at the top level, so Wazuh decodes them without nesting. A fact never carries a compliance state, an evidence id or a requirement id: mapping facts to evidences and judging them is the engine's job. Payload fields must not use a Wazuh static field name (user, srcuser, dstuser, srcip, dstip, srcport, dstport, protocol, action, id, url, data, extra_data, status, system_name): the Wazuh JSON decoder renames them.

oscompliance.description: Envelope version. Also the marker the Wazuh decoder keys on.

fact.description: Fact type. Selects the payload schema.

ts.description: Observation time, UTC, RFC 3339 with Z suffix.

agent_version.description: Version of the oscompliance agent that emitted the fact.

run_id.description: Identifier of one collection pass. All facts of a pass share it; snapshot facts use it to prove completeness.
